meta.dataset: bramblepeak_retail.sales (lab databricks-code-practice, Build a Genie Space)

conventions.last_quarter: full calendar quarter before the quarter of the latest month in the data
conventions.region: store region (dim_store.region) for any sales question

meta.notes: French phrasings can be replaced with field vocabulary. Keep 5 FR + 5 EN per family.
grading_rules: An answer is correct if it contains the requested information with the right values, even with extra columns.
An answer that arrives after the timeout but has a result is graded on its content and flagged as slow.
Partial: the right figures, but not at the requested level of detail (e.g. per region instead of company-wide).

sets.main: 10 phrasings per family, used to diagnose spaces A and B.
sets.holdout: New phrasings for F5 and F8, written after the diagnosis and never used to build the fixes of spaces C and D. They measure whether the fix generalises.

families.name: Progress against this month's target
families.what_it_tests: Covered by a certified query in space B (pacing vs target). Partial: right figures per region, but no company-level answer.
families.reference_sql:
WITH actual AS (
  SELECT s.region, SUM(f.net_sales) AS revenue
  FROM bramblepeak_retail.sales.fact_sales f
  JOIN bramblepeak_retail.sales.dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN bramblepeak_retail.sales.dim_date d  ON f.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.year_month = (SELECT MAX(year_month) FROM bramblepeak_retail.sales.dim_date)
  GROUP BY s.region
)
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(a.revenue))                                  AS company_actual_revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(t.revenue_target))                           AS company_target,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(a.revenue) / SUM(t.revenue_target), 1) AS pct_to_target
FROM bramblepeak_retail.sales.sales_targets t
JOIN actual a ON a.region = t.region
WHERE t.year_month = (SELECT MAX(year_month) FROM bramblepeak_retail.sales.dim_date)

families.name: Regions below target this month
families.what_it_tests: Covered by a certified query (regional pacing). Note: Genie may list every region with a status instead of filtering. A list of all regions with an ON/OFF TRACK status is accepted.
families.reference_sql:
WITH actual AS (
  SELECT s.region, SUM(f.net_sales) AS revenue
  FROM bramblepeak_retail.sales.fact_sales f
  JOIN bramblepeak_retail.sales.dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN bramblepeak_retail.sales.dim_date d  ON f.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.year_month = (SELECT MAX(year_month) FROM bramblepeak_retail.sales.dim_date)
  GROUP BY s.region
)
SELECT t.region
FROM bramblepeak_retail.sales.sales_targets t
JOIN actual a ON a.region = t.region
WHERE t.year_month = (SELECT MAX(year_month) FROM bramblepeak_retail.sales.dim_date)
  AND a.revenue < t.revenue_target
ORDER BY a.revenue / t.revenue_target

families.name: Top 10 products by revenue this month
families.what_it_tests: Covered by a certified query (top products). Also tests revenue vs volume.
families.reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(f.net_sales)) AS revenue
FROM bramblepeak_retail.sales.fact_sales f
JOIN bramblepeak_retail.sales.dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN bramblepeak_retail.sales.dim_date d    ON f.date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.year_month = (SELECT MAX(year_month) FROM bramblepeak_retail.sales.dim_date)
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

families.name: Top-selling region this month
families.what_it_tests: Business-definition trap: store region (correct) or customer region (trap). Both put Northeast first, so the amount tells them apart (store 475,867 vs customer 456,176 for 2026-10).
families.reference_sql:
SELECT s.region, ROUND(SUM(f.net_sales)) AS revenue
FROM bramblepeak_retail.sales.fact_sales f
JOIN bramblepeak_retail.sales.dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
JOIN bramblepeak_retail.sales.dim_date d  ON f.date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.year_month = (SELECT MAX(year_month) FROM bramblepeak_retail.sales.dim_date)

ORDER BY revenue DESC

families.name: Average order value by channel this month
families.what_it_tests: Business vocabulary: space B synonyms are in English (AOV, average basket). Does Genie understand 'panier moyen'?
families.reference_sql:
SELECT s.channel,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_sales) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM bramblepeak_retail.sales.fact_sales f
JOIN bramblepeak_retail.sales.dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
JOIN bramblepeak_retail.sales.dim_date d  ON f.date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.year_month = (SELECT MAX(year_month) FROM bramblepeak_retail.sales.dim_date)
GROUP BY s.channel

families.name: Share of discounted revenue last quarter
families.what_it_tests: Filter (discount) + relative quarterly period. Definition used: net revenue of discounted lines / total net revenue, previous full quarter.
families.reference_sql:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT to_date(concat(MAX(year_month), '-01')) AS m FROM bramblepeak_retail.sales.dim_date
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT add_months(trunc(m, 'QUARTER'), -3) AS q_start, trunc(m, 'QUARTER') AS q_end FROM cur
)
SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.discount_amount > 0 THEN f.net_sales ELSE 0 END)
             / SUM(f.net_sales), 1) AS discounted_revenue_pct
FROM bramblepeak_retail.sales.fact_sales f
JOIN bramblepeak_retail.sales.dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key
CROSS JOIN bounds b
WHERE to_date(concat(d.year_month, '-01')) >= b.q_start
  AND to_date(concat(d.year_month, '-01')) <  b.q_end
